text: I am feeling pretty good .   I am motivated to finish the process of closing the mortgage loan I am working on .   Laughing with my mom .   I feel happy about the opportunity to talking with her since she has dementia and she is alert enough for a discussion .

I am feeling content with myself .   I am doing the best I can and not responding too emotionally .   I believe that I am getting better with sticking with what I am wanting to do and not running when it gets to hard or doesn’t go the way I want it to .

Feeling sad because I lost a close friend who was part of the family to a heart attack .   My Mom and younger brother is taking very hard and I don’t want them to feel sad . Death can come so suddenly when you are not expecting .   My last husband died of a heart attack and I guess it brought back memories .

I am feeling very happy going to church service the scripture always makes me feel happy .   Family is doing well .   Blessed to see another day .   I am feeling happy .   I am grateful and thankful .   I am doing well .   Feeling happy

I feel happy life is going well and working out for my good and learning .   I am in the right place doing the right thing at the right time .   Life is what you choose to make it and I plan on making the rest of my life the best life for me .

I am feeling kind of content .   Heard from my daughter as usual not to say hello or check on me but to ask for money .   Does she even care or care for me to help her financially only .   Something has to change with this relationship .

I am happy that I cleared the air with my daughter .   I am not a confronting type of person but I must learn to be so I can get it out instead of holding feelings in and letting it bother me .   I am happy that I have taken a step to get better and love myself .

Feeling happy because I am working on walking in my purpose which is being a Mortgage loan officer and helping as many people as I can become homeowners .   So happy I said yes to myself . Be happy and don’t worry .

Feeling happy with everything got done today .   Trying to make sure important things that need to be done get done . Happy today was a good day . Ending the day strong .   Finishing my day watching a movie .
